honest_framing_note: Combined R² can be negative when the learned predictor is worse than the constant-mean baseline. Post-fix R² is WORSE than pre-fix because the pre-fix -1.50 was an artifact of the ASTSR-collapse trick (constant predictor yielding R² ≈ -0.014), which the Wf-122 P1.2 scale-guard correctly rejects. The post-fix -5.66 is the TRUE R² on the Wf-49 §Cause 2 signal-floor regime (every F5_RDKIT_2D feature has |ρ| < 0.02 on PlatinAI pIC50). Wf-139 P4 close-out (TODO/completed/137_l5_l7_l10_arch_ceiling_honest.md) confirms this is an ARCHITECTURAL CEILING: 3 independent Wf rescue attempts (Wf-127 Hilbert L2 + ASTSR scale; Wf-128 172-d multi-task + Wasserstein; Wf-129 Multi-PH+PLL + Wasserstein + L2) all converge on the same 12-d RDKit signal floor. The architectural fix for lifting R² ≥ 0 is Multi-PH + PLL feature augmentation with REAL 172-d features (Wf-94 / TODO-94 R20-P3 GPU retrain, ETA Q1) combined with AlphaFold-Multimer protein-aware descriptors (R22-P4, ETA +6-12 mo) and wet-lab pIC50 labels (R23-P6, ETA +12-18 mo). See TODO/completed/111_wf85_r2_root_fix.md for full close-out, TODO/completed/137_l5_l7_l10_arch_ceiling_honest.md for the consolidated Wf-139 P4 architectural-ceiling doc, and wf122_p3_post_fix/synthesis.md for pre/post comparison.

wf129_p3_multiph_pll_guarded_l7_lift_cav.description: Wf-129 P3 Multi-PH + PLL end-to-end guarded retrain (Hilbert L2 + ASTSR scale + W₂ pIC50 distribution regulariser) MEASURED on PlatinAI 4-cell at hilbert_dim=64. Does NOT lift the 12-d RDKit signal floor — the R² = -0.0780 ± 0.0148 (5 seeds × n=200) is honest-negative vs the LAMBDA_ROADMAP §4.2 L7 + R20-P3 gate R² ≥ +0.30. The Hilbert L2 + ASTSR scale + W₂ pIC50 regularisers PREVENT divergence (no fold produced r2 = -inf; no ASTSR collapse fires; all l2_penalty_last finite) but the architecture-level signal floor remains. Per-seed × cell-line R² reported in molmetal/reports/wf129_p3_multiph_pll/{MCF7,A549,A2780,A2780cis}/per_seed_metrics.json. Wf-129 P3 is LESS NEGATIVE than Wf-122 P3 post-fix (-5.66 → -0.0780, +5.58 R² delta) on the no-collapse PlatinAI 4-cell — consistent with Hilbert L2 proximal shrinkage + W₂ pIC50 distribution regulariser stabilising per-fold predictions, but still well below the +0.30 gate. Real lift requires Wf-94 R20-P3 Multi-PH + PLL real feature augmentation (32-bin Fourier + 128-d PLL signature, NOT zero-padded).

wf_r44_eval_guard_mode_c_fix.defect_found: bench_hilbert_astr_combined_real.py::_collapse_detected (eval-time diagnostic behind the `collapse_detected` field on every per-seed record and the JSON's `collapse_detected_post_fix = 0 of 20` claim) detected ONLY mode A (std-ratio collapse). It was blind to mode C — a wrong-variable AST with std ratio ~1.0 that regresses on the wrong feature at R2 <= 0. MEASURED on real PlatinAI mcf7: ASTSR best AST = (min v_RingCount v_HBD) at train R2 = -116.3, or with the Wf-122 P3 bench seed (mul (add (add v_FractionCSP3 c_1.0) c_1.0) c_2.0) at train R2 = -2.6092, std ratio 1.308 -> pre-fix _collapse_detected = False. The '0 of 20 collapse' diagnostic was therefore a FALSE NEGATIVE on the exact seeds that produced R2 = -5.66.
wf_r44_eval_guard_mode_c_fix.fix: Added SCALE_MISMATCH_TOLERANCE (mode B, previously absent from this bench copy) + WRONG_VARIABLE_R2_FLOOR = 0.0 (mode C) to molmetal/scripts/bench_hilbert_astr_combined_real.py::_collapse_detected so the eval-time diagnostic is honest. CPU-only; eval-time only, does NOT touch the evolutionary search (a selection-time R2<=0 filter was tried and REVERTED — it kills the initial random population and breaks test_astsr_rdkit_2d_extended_toy_r2_above_threshold).
wf_r44_eval_guard_mode_c_fix.fix_verify: molmetal/tests/test_hilbert_astr_combined_real.py + test_hilbert_astr_post_fix_smoke.py = 32 passed (incl. 2 NEW mode-B/mode-C tests). Post-fix _collapse_detected fires True on the real mcf7 wrong-variable AST; False on a signal prediction (R2>0.5).
wf_r44_eval_guard_mode_c_fix.scope_caveat: The guard is a DIAGNOSTIC, not a signal source. It flags the wrong-variable regime honestly but does NOT lift the L5 ceiling. The true achievable linear R2 on the 12-d RDKit features is ~0 (OLS on real mcf7: train +0.0088, max |rho| 0.022), so the ceiling half of this JSON's verdict stands. The defect fixed here is that the collapse diagnostic was itself a false negative, not that the metric is liftable.
